title: Bromus five-way crew comparison incl rescuegrass without installing extra taxon
reason: The Bromus genus contains four existing canonical species and the rescuegrass reference is a look-alike, not an approved canonical species. Preserved/improved concurrent in-repo photo work with seven source-credited panels, 11 existing gross photo arrows and five additional source-verified photo arrows. Corrected Japanese brome unreliable old 10–15 mm cutoff, emphasized FNA/extension lower:upper glume venation native Texas brome 1/3 vs Japanese 3–5/7, and included real rescuegrass strongly flattened short/no-awn comparison with rights safe source.

qa.licenses: Per-source CC BY-SA and CC BY, original CC BY-NC and public domain captions preserved.
missing_true_features: 1-mm mature glumes and lower/upper veins of B. texensis vs B. japonicus, matched Texas specimens
Whole rooted life-stage (annual vs perennial) and true ligule/leaf sheath details
Measured awn and complete lemma length for the four installed species and rescuegrass
